name: The Kelpfang
description: A whale-bone trawler, captained by Varuna and navigated by Mitra.
notes: The Current Era counterpart to the Survival Train, and the setting the Varuna and Mitra entries are drawn from. Named in both of their `roles` -- Captain of the Kelpfang, Navigator of the Kelpfang -- while being nowhere in canon as a thing those roles could point at.
sources: Resonant Hearts: Intimate Chronicles Aboard the Kelpfang
